text:
Maria Chen: Kicked off a canary: v2.1-int4 vs v2.0-fp16 on docs/summarization, sample=2k, traffic=5%. quick snapshot: p95 +18ms, avg +12ms, MRR delta -1.3% overall, long-doc hallucination +0.6pp.
Sam Patel: any auto-fallback signals? :thinking_face:
Maria Chen: current auto-fallback: mrr_drop_pct=2.0, hallucination_pct_delta=1.0, latency_p95_increase_ms=20. deploy-bot started canary at 1758643201 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary started: v2.1-int4 vs v2.0-fp16, 5% traffic. logs -> https://internal.redwood/canaries/1758643201
Lee Johnson: slice breakdown?
Maria Chen: long-docs: baseline MRR 0.364 -> candidate 0.359 (-1.4%), hallucination 0.8% -> 1.6% (+0.8pp), p95 210ms -> 230ms (+20ms). short-answers: MRR -0.6%, hallucination 0.3% -> 0.4%.
Sam Patel: long-doc hallucination +0.8pp close to the 1.0pp threshold; p95 right at +20ms limit.
Lee Johnson: our rule is two-strike: mrr_drop OR hallucination_delta triggers fallback. Here neither strictly trips (mrr -1.4% > -2.0% threshold).
Maria Chen: proposal: tighten hallucination threshold for long-docs to 0.5pp during early canary and require MRR drop >1.5% AND hallucination >0.5pp to auto-fallback. also add hysteresis: 3 consecutive 5-min windows. example gatebook snippet I pushed:
```
canary_gate:
  selectors: [slice: long-docs]
  rules:
    - name: early-guard-long-docs
      metrics: [mrr_delta_pct <= -1.5, hallucination_pp_delta >= 0.5]
      window_minutes: 5
      consecutive_windows: 3
      action: auto_fallback
```
Sam Patel: ok. also consider hybrid absolute/delta hallucination since tiny baselines make delta noisy.
Lee Johnson: agree. if baseline hallucination <1% use absolute >1.0% check.
Maria Chen: noted; will make hybrid rule and document. ran quick bootstrap on MRR: p~0.12 with 2k (underpowered). need ~8k to detect 1% with 80% power. I'm increasing canary to 15% for 30m to get more samples. ops ok?
Lee Johnson: fine for 30m, ops aware.
Sam Patel: add human-flagged hallucination metric from feedback pipeline too.
Maria Chen: added. final actions: 1) tighten long-doc guard, 2) require 3x5min windows, 3) hybrid absolute/delta comparator, 4) bump sample to 15% for 30m. rollback if auto_fallback triggers or MRR p < 0.05 after 30m. I'll post results at 1758643620. :thumbsup:
